extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: vertical pressure vessel / air receiver, 0.8 m diameter, approx. 2.1 m tall
extras.notes: coral painted vessel with dished heads and soft weld beads on four steel pipe legs with foot plates; pressure gauge without numbers (tick marks, green/orange arc, needle) on a front pipe bend; brass safety valve with pull ring on top; side flange nozzle with gate valve and orange handwheel, second nozzle with ball valve lever, drain cock below; oval handhole with yoke, blank name plate (no text), lifting lugs; front = -Y; no moving parts; no text, no numbers

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
